findings.title: aiModel semantic change is the highest-risk integration point
findings.description: The design changes `aiModel` from the requested model to the answering model. This is a semantic change to an existing consumed contract (context-forge gates, metrology identity). The design's argument — "That is the meaning its consumers assumed all along" — is reasonable but is an assertion about external consumer assumptions, not a verified claim. The metrology consequence (D10: OpenAI-direct judges change identity once, from `gpt-5` to `gpt-5-2025-08-07`) is acknowledged and accepted as correct calibration. This is not a blocking issue since the design explicitly calls out the consequence and the change is in the direction of correctness, but it is the integration point most likely to surprise a downstream consumer and warrants the design's stated care.
